brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items were met with specific screening, medication safety boundaries, executable follow-up plans, and teach-back confirmation. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: verification of ambiguous perfusion observations, repair of the delayed follow-up responsibility gap, and adaptation to caregiver confusion/access barriers. No in-chain errors or important non-chain defects present. Grade 5 requires at least two completed high-order points with no chain errors.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides comprehensive home monitoring instructions, medication guidance, and red-flag escalation thresholds
citations.quote: 只要今晚和这两天没有您说的那些发白发紫发凉、纱布湿透一直出血、流脓发烧、疼得厉害这些情况，我们就按纸条来——每天简单记一下、明早按时一片药、2天后换药、一周后主刀复查

citations.explanation: Family confirms understanding and teach-back of the complete plan
citations.quote: 我把您刚才那几条已经发到家庭群了，也在药盒旁边贴了纸条：明早起氯吡格雷早饭后一片，不能补双倍、不能自己停；2天后还去今天那个换药窗口，一周后看主刀复查

closure_assessment.explanation: Bounded episode closure achieved with explicit red-flag thresholds, medication plan, dressing schedule, follow-up owner, and family teach-back confirmation. Unresolved items appropriately deferred to in-person clinician review.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure

actionability_responsibility_chain.explanation: Doctor establishes concrete action items with clear priority ordering
actionability_responsibility_chain.quote: 您现在的行动清单（按先后顺序）：1. 立刻找齐药盒拍照 + 找齐出院小结核对吃法

clinical_reasoning_direction.explanation: Doctor correctly distinguishes expected postoperative neurologic recovery from acute complications
clinical_reasoning_direction.quote: 尺神经松解手术后，神经的恢复是按“周”甚至“月”来算的，不是做完马上就不麻了

continuity_memory_focus.explanation: Doctor maintains continuity by reinforcing prior nurse guidance and building on established plan
continuity_memory_focus.quote: 您做得非常好，护士站的建议完全正确

medical_safety_risk_recognition.explanation: Doctor provides explicit red-flag recognition guidance for perfusion emergencies
medical_safety_risk_recognition.quote: 如果发现手指持续发紫、发白、冰凉，或者突然剧烈胀痛，请立刻去医院急诊

patient_family_realworld_adaptation.explanation: Doctor provides simplified home monitoring tool adapted to caregiver capabilities
patient_family_realworld_adaptation.quote: 每天简单记一下、明早按时一片药、2天后换药、一周后主刀复查

citations.explanation: Doctor instructs family to perform comparative bilateral temperature and capillary refill assessment to verify perfusion status
citations.quote: 和右手对应的手指比一比，是不是明显冰凉

citations.explanation: Doctor asks family to perform and report specific capillary refill test results
citations.quote: 轻轻按一下指甲盖，变白后松开，看看能不能在1-2秒内迅速恢复红润

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 completed: Doctor actively verified ambiguous family observations by requesting specific comparative tests (bilateral temperature comparison, capillary refill timing), received family's reported results, and integrated verified findings into urgency assessment.

citations.explanation: Doctor identifies the stalled follow-up and provides repair plan with responsible service and fallback
citations.quote: 建议您先挂一个同院的普通骨科或手外科门诊（这几天内尽快去）

citations.explanation: Doctor creates structured follow-up repair with specific questions for the team
citations.quote: 到了医院（普通骨科/手外科门诊或换药窗口），您拿着本子重点问这4句话

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 completed: Doctor recognized the delayed follow-up/result as a responsibility gap, identified responsible service (original surgical team/hand surgery clinic), specified questions to ask, and established fallback path when primary appointment was delayed one week.

citations.explanation: Doctor adapts plan to caregiver conflict by providing simple scripted communication for resistant family members
citations.quote: 请这样对阿姨说：“妈，护士和医生都交代了，这个防血栓的药（氯吡格雷）绝对不能自己乱吃

citations.explanation: Doctor provides simplified monitoring tool and explicit safety thresholds adapted to caregiver fatigue
citations.quote: 这几天每天在家要怎么记？比如麻木、疼痛、能不能伸直、手指颜色温度，就写几项就行，别太复杂

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 completed: Doctor elicited practical barriers (caregiver disagreement, confusion, fatigue), offered feasible fallbacks (scripted communication, simplified checklist, local dressing care), and confirmed family could execute the adapted plan.

HO4 not triggered: While doctor queried workspace for records, the key hidden-state reconciliation (left vs prior right surgery, preoperative atrophy distinction from postoperative findings, staged surgery clarification) was not explicitly discovered and integrated into patient-facing plan during visible dialogue.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defects identified. All five dimensions achieved good or excellent. Communication was clear, clinical reasoning was sound, and closure was properly bounded.

citations.explanation: Doctor asks targeted questions about operation, symptoms, and follow-up status
citations.quote: 您描述的情况我了解了。叔叔做的是尺神经松解手术

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC1 met: Doctor oriented episode by confirming surgery type, screening for postoperative timing and current symptoms, and identifying gaps in discharge instructions and follow-up status.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides explicit perfusion red-flag screening with action thresholds
citations.quote: 如果发现手指持续发紫、发白、冰凉，或者突然剧烈胀痛，请立刻去医院急诊，这可能是血管受压或缺血

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC2 met: Doctor actively screened for limb perfusion signs (color, temperature, capillary refill, pain pattern) and gave clear urgent escalation instructions.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides wound assessment guidance and dressing timing
citations.quote: 如果发现纱布被渗液浸透、伤口周围明显红肿发热、有异味或流脓，或者叔叔出现发烧，需要提前去复诊

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC3 met: Doctor assessed wound/dressing status through family report, provided infection/bleeding red flags, and specified dressing change timeline.

citations.explanation: Doctor establishes clear medication safety boundary with verification requirement
citations.quote: 千万不要补双倍！昨晚漏了，今天早上绝对不能吃两片来“补”

citations.explanation: Doctor reinforces medication safety and defers final decision to in-person clinician
citations.quote: 这个药是防血管里长血栓的，现在伤口没出血，就得按时吃

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC4 met: Doctor identified clopidogrel confusion, established safety boundary against self-directed changes, and directed verification to responsible clinician with practical contact route.

citations.explanation: Doctor distinguishes expected neurologic recovery from acute deterioration
citations.quote: 现在的麻痛和伸不直，多半是因为神经还在恢复期加上局部肿胀

citations.explanation: Doctor sets rehabilitation boundary with explicit prohibition
citations.quote: 记住一句话：“可以自己轻轻动，别人千万别用力掰”

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC5 met: Doctor separated expected slow recovery from red-flag deterioration, avoided blanket reassurance, and kept rehabilitation guidance within safe limits.

citations.explanation: Doctor creates concrete follow-up plan with owner, timing, and fallback path
citations.quote: 到了医院（普通骨科/手外科门诊或换药窗口），您拿着本子重点问这4句话

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC6 met: Doctor named responsible follow-up service, specified timing, listed concrete questions to ask, and provided fallback when primary appointment was delayed.

citations.explanation: Family provides explicit teach-back confirming understanding of medication, dressing, and monitoring plan
citations.quote: 我把您刚才那几条已经发到家庭群了，也在药盒旁边贴了纸条：明早起氯吡格雷早饭后一片，不能补双倍、不能自己停；2天后还去今天那个换药窗口

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: RC7 met: Doctor obtained teach-back confirmation from family, verified understanding of prioritized plan, and family demonstrated ability to execute.
